scope: Approval binds exact plan bytes and governing roadmap. Production implementation, IF gates, EC acceptance and merge admission remain unfulfilled. This receipt does not claim review of its own future commit.

implementation_review_controls: Unchanged default DATA retention corpus plus pure atomic selection; genuine active-session heartbeat reclamation and bounded completed-session churn.
Reclamation proposals may conservatively exceed committed subset; pure synchronous callback, fresh reference checks and durable recovery before registry/watermark publication.
Freeze one tie-safe continuation total order and test equal timestamps, head mismatch, restart before watermark publication and older independently referenced metadata.
Cursor pagination order is a distinct contract from sequential-continuation revision order; validate both without assuming they share keys.
Keep protected-capacity and progress-marker failures truthful; per-lease quarantine and actual exited-child/path proof.

COORD lease selection overrides DATA scoped-history keeps for worktree rows; retained-session references mean entity references. Test heartbeats with an open holder session/running turn and long-lived open-session lease churn.

Before invoking synchronous compactRecords, durably journal candidate IDs/intended watermarks; callback prunes only journaled still-eligible candidates. Publish eviction/watermark together only for IDs with no surviving lease row.
Quarantine covers repo+branch collisions across modes and canonical path; pending acquisitions occupy that domain.
Apply the tie-safe continuation order to live candidate selection as well as reclamation; ambiguous tied clean/dirty evidence must not grant unsafe reuse.
Name durable COORD-managed root marker; verify legacy denial preserves map/ledger bytes, standalone compatibility and both first-use orders.
Document fail-closed sequential continuation after aged tombstone reclamation and retainHistory contention/heartbeat implications.
